reversibilityClass.description: reversible: outcome can be undone with no lasting effect (e.g. read-only queries, idempotent config sets). deferred_reversible: outcome can be undone but requires effort and time (e.g. production deploy — rollback is possible but costly). irreversible: outcome cannot be undone (e.g. database schema drop, financial wire transfer, physical actuation). Used to gate approval requirements and to classify evidence bundles.

haltTrigger.description: revocation: a scope revocation swept or polled during execution (PROD-D9). lease_expired: the continuous-authorization lease TTL elapsed without renewal. policy_changed: the governing policy was updated to deny during execution. manual: a human operator issued an explicit halt. cascade_halt: a parent execution was halted and the halt cascaded to this child execution.

principalType.description: human: a natural person. org: an organization acting as a principal. service: a software service account or API key holder. agent: an autonomous AI agent operating on behalf of a human or org. device: a physical device or robot acting under delegated authority. The 'agent' and 'device' types are reserved for the v2/v3 delegation model; no behavioral difference from 'service' in v1.x.

permitStatus.description: active: permit is valid and may be used. expired: TTL elapsed or lease_expires_at passed without renewal. revoked: a matching scope_revocations entry was swept (PROD-D9). consumed: permit was used for a one-shot action and may not be reused.

delegationAncestryEntry.description: One hop in the delegation chain from originating principal to executing actor. Index 0 in an ancestry array is the top-level grant (closest to the originating principal). Captured immutably at permit issuance time.

attestationProvider.description: Well-known attestation providers: spiffe (SPIFFE/SVID x509 workload identity), tpm (Trusted Platform Module hardware attestation), enclave (confidential computing: AMD SEV / Intel TDX / AWS Nitro), oidc (OIDC identity token). Custom providers use the form 'custom:<identifier>'.

simulationScenarioType.description: single_agent: one actor, one action class, baseline pass/fail. delegation_chain: tests a full N-hop delegation ancestry chain. concurrent_fleet: N concurrent agents executing the same action class — tests contention and permit issuance under load. blast_radius: simulate POST /v1/revoke-scope and count how many active permits match the revocation scope pattern. cascade_halt: simulate a parent execution halt and measure how many child executions receive the cascade signal. policy_drift: simulate a policy version change mid-execution and measure decision divergence.

forbiddenContextKey.description: Keys that AtlaSent rejects as input. Behavioral / emotional / pattern inference is out of scope.

safeContext.description: Whitelisted context shape. Forbidden keys MUST be rejected with HTTP 400.
